threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it ‘the tube’ instead of just taking the Overground like a local. The awks when you’re stood there waiting for a train.
Last week on the 59, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with 90s R&B. Half the passengers were singing along, completely ignoring the driver.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a wedding procession using the BVG bus as their float, everyone just cheering and clapping, that was Neukölln for me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous dance parties in the U-Bahn stations here. Just the other week at Samariterstraße, a crowd gathered for a surprise rave!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the taco truck on 24th hits different after a night out, while the tourists pile into the overpriced burrito joints.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo exit the 31-Philosopher, adjust his tie, and stroll right into the opera house. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think the best tapas are in the fancy spots, but it's the tiny bars with locals that have the real deal. Less flash, more flavor.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones fumbling with the metro map at Girona station while locals breeze by, smartphones in hand. So eager to explore, yet still lost in translation.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to the Overground as the 'Orange Line' and think it's a big deal when it's on time.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week. The driver turned up the reggae, and suddenly, it felt like a mini carnival with everyone singing along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The night the buskers took over the streets during the BVG strike, I realized this place thrives on its chaos and creativity.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous techno parties in empty warehouses here. Just a random flyer on a lamp post can lead to an unforgettable night.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s really from the Mission—they're the ones who know the taco trucks by their first names. The new folks just stick to the taquerias.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo playing the accordion on the 38 Geary this morning. Only in SF can you get a concert while stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals are in bars at night. Ever noticed the quiet streets after 10 PM? That's when we recharge for the next busy day.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they stare at the metro map like it's a puzzle. Locals? We only need to know the next stop.
